seeds.scenarios: dodge_vision._split_plan: np.random.default_rng(np.random.SeedSequence([runtime_seed, split_code])), first n of sample_threat_scenarios
seeds.augmentation: np.random.default_rng(np.random.SeedSequence([runtime_seed, split_code], spawn_key=(scenario_id,)).spawn(2)[1]), fresh for every episode of the scenario (paired)

calibration.rule: precision >= target: highest recall, then fewer false activations, then higher threat, action, margin

seeds.scenarios: dodge_vision._split_plan: np.random.default_rng(np.random.SeedSequence([runtime_seed, split_code])), first n of sample_threat_scenarios
seeds.augmentation: np.random.default_rng(np.random.SeedSequence([runtime_seed, split_code], spawn_key=(scenario_id,)).spawn(2)[1]), fresh for every episode of the scenario (paired)

calibration.t_hit: Go2World.finish_episode first_collision_time_s of the NO_OP episode
calibration.source: offline: the saved NO_OP trace (dodge_eval trace), windows rebuilt from its frames, readouts batched through observed.student_readout, the same gate replay as calibrate

readout_check.method: np.random.default_rng(runtime.seed).choice of (scenario, decision frame) without replacement; DodgeRuntime.readout of that window against the batched observed.student_readout

sweep.rule: qualifies: offline dev calibration's chosen triple has precision >= inference.gate.precision_target and emitted >= observed.dodge_vision.sweep.min_emitted; among qualifying: highest dev recall, ties -> fewer frames, then smaller hidden size (total units, then layers, then sizes in order), then encoding order as listed; none qualifying: no winner, nothing relaxed
